name: thumbhash-headtohead
description: ChromaHash at ThumbHash's own byte cost. ThumbHash is 21 B on this corpus (landscape photos, no alpha); the shipped format cannot go below 32 B, so these are hypothetical sub-tier-0 layouts. Incumbent is the 21 B layout the shipped 26:9 / 5 b:4 b constants would produce if simply scaled down. Every arm pins all four selection/encoder knobs: 'stack' is the three-knob aniso+fit2+nearest form and the plain rows are the PRE-adoption signal path. Without this the plain rows inherit the adopted knobs and become byte-identical to their own +stack rows.
